title: Amazing
body: Has all functions I need from a habit tracker, a beautifully minimal UI, and there’s no subscription
author: ヽ(T^T)ノ

title: Love it, but one thing is missing
body: Great minimalistic app. I would appreciate some statistics (chart) to know how much time I’ve focused in a month - something like the app “study bunny” has
author: Praguestudent

title: Great habit tracker
body: It’s a very simple and minimalistic app, which I love, great for daily tasks. I like how it has a journal and focus sections so you don’t have to use other apps for that. I wish it had a section for planning non-daily tasks, too, since right now I have to use other apps to plan my day.
author: udaltsovaaaa

title: Best in all ways.
body: Most compete and functional habit tracker out there. No fluff, no extra features, snappy minimal interface, no ads and in app purchases. What more can I say. 😊 highly recommended.
author: Asscid1

title: Love it!
body: I’m really impressed with this app, it’s exactly what I’ve been searching for. The minimal design is great, and I appreciate that it doesn’t include any unnecessary features. It’s very well executed and I use it everyday!
author: luciatorrens
